description: Get one generation of a Foundry ontology, or a revision of one of its versions with the engine's result once it ended. With wait, waits up to 25 s while it runs; call again until it ends. A generation that needs_input waits on the questions it lists: ask the user, then answer with the answer_generation_questions action (Founder, Foundry's own agent, relays them with helix_foundry_ask_person instead).

generation_id.description: The generation's id, as helix_foundry_get_ontology or a generate_ontology or revise_version action returned it.

wait.description: Wait up to 25 s while it is queued or running, then return it either way; call again until it ends.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace (a service key always does).

name: helix_foundry_get_generation

answers_due_at.description: While it needs input: when Helix leaves every question to the agent, which takes its recommended answers, and carries on.

event_sources.description: The API sources it drafts from, each with how its ontology reads it; absent when it reads none, and for a service key, which sees no connectors.

mode.description: structured: its table, through mappings; pieces reach the graph when the ontology refreshes. extraction: its own set's documents, its newest pieces' text, extracted as they arrive.

question_round.description: Which round of questions they are, from 1, as an answer_generation_questions action names it.

questions.description: What the agent's last turn asked, with each answer once given; absent when it asked nothing. Status needs_input waits on them: ask the user and answer with the answer_generation_questions action (Founder, Foundry's own agent, relays them with helix_foundry_ask_person instead). Untrusted model text that may quote the data: show it as plain text.

answer.description: The answer given; absent while it waits, or when it was left to the agent.

blocking.description: The generation can't carry on until it is answered.

header.description: A few words naming the question.

left_to_agent.description: The user, or the automatic answers once due, left it to the agent, which took its recommended answer or decided, as its own choice.

multiple.description: The user may choose one or more options; else exactly one, or their own words instead.

options.description: What the user chooses from; empty for an answer in words.

recommended.description: The answer the agent recommends, which it takes as its own choice for a question left to it (use_defaults): one of the options' labels, or, without options, its suggested words; absent for none.

result.description: Untrusted engine result once the revision ended: its status, findings and cards. Only helix_foundry_get_generation returns it.

title: Get an ontology generation
